title.en: Tale 19 — The Monkey and the Tortoise

sentences.en: A monkey and a tortoise became friends on the shore.

sentences.ar: القرد كان يرمي لها تين من الشجرة.
sentences.en: The monkey used to throw her figs from the tree.

sentences.ar: مرت السلحفاة زعلت وقالت إنها مريضة.
sentences.en: The tortoise’s wife was jealous and said she was ill.

sentences.ar: قالت: ما بيشفيني إلا قلب قرد.
sentences.en: She said: nothing will cure me but a monkey’s heart.

sentences.ar: السلحفاة حملت صاحبها عالبحر وهي حزينة.
sentences.en: The tortoise carried her friend out to sea, and she was sad.

sentences.ar: بالنص، ما قدرت تسكت وحكت له.
sentences.en: Halfway, she could not keep silent and told him.

sentences.ar: قال القرد: ليش ما قلتي من الأول؟
sentences.en: The monkey said: why did you not say so at the start?
My heart is left on the tree; let me fetch it.

sentences.ar: رجعوا، وطلع القرد عالشجرة وما نزل.
sentences.en: They went back, and the monkey climbed the tree and did not come down.
